signals_info.description: Whether effective traction is lost; 0 means effective traction is available.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 1 and 3 seconds from now, traction loss shall equal 0.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 1 秒到第 3 秒之间，牵引力丧失状态应至少有一个时刻为 0。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the window from the first through the third second, the vehicle shall have effective traction at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 1 秒至第 3 秒的窗口内，车辆应至少有一个时刻具备有效牵引力。
